subject: Document coordination conflict on the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the

messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the building corner are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? This is routine and can be worked into the normal submittal cycle. This could affect the contract sum depending on the resolution. This could affect the submittal review schedule. No hard deadline, just would like to keep this moving. It is not clear whether this reflects a real design decision that needs interpreting, or just a documentation error that should be corrected without changing intent.

Door and Window Schedule A-601 is the condition to build to for the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the building corner; we'll reconcile Detail 5/A501 by addendum. This could affect the contract sum depending on the resolution. This could affect the submittal review schedule.
